name: Lex Computech Co., Ltd.
summary: Lex Computech Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise, established in 1990 in New Taipei, specializing in the development and distribution of robust industrial computing solutions. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses industrial-grade motherboards, passively cooled embedded systems, resilient panel PCs, network infrastructure devices, and controllers for machine vision and industrial automation. Moreover, they provide advanced solutions for AI edge computing and the Internet of Things (IoT). These offerings cater to a diverse range of demanding applications and sectors, including Edge AI and gateway solutions, general IoT deployments, automation, network appliances, transportation, medical, military, aerospace, and government.
